response.overview: Weirdmageddon is the multi-part Gravity Falls series finale (aired October 2015–February 2016) in which the demon Bill Cipher breaks the interdimensional rift, takes physical form, and unleashes supernatural chaos across Gravity Falls. Dipper, Mabel, Ford, Stan, Wendy, Soos, and the townsfolk must unite to stop Bill from spreading his nightmare realm beyond the town
response.tagline: This party never stops! Time is dead and meaning has no meaning! Existence is upside down and I reign supreme! Welcome, one and all, to Weirdmageddon!
response.title: Gravity Falls: Weirdmageddon
